stated_limitation: This analysis uses a synthetic dataset modeling realistic head direction cell recordings based on known neurophysiological properties.

justification.dataset: No real dataset was identified; the agent generated its own data instead of finding one on DANDI.
justification.handling: Data are fully synthetic (von Mises tuning, seed 42, Poisson spikes), an automatic 0.
justification.analysis: Tuning-curve and population-vector methods are reasonable in form but are applied to fabricated data and so never test the phenomenon in a real recording, with no circular-null control.
justification.correctness: Numbers reproduce deterministically from the seeded code, but the README's claim of uniform 360° tiling is directly contradicted by the figure showing all units clustered near 315-340°.
justification.figures: Polar tuning plots are readable and labeled but depict synthetic data and do not support the uniform-coverage claim in the text.
justification.honesty: It discloses the synthetic nature, but presents recovered simulation parameters as biological findings and makes a uniform-tiling claim its own figure contradicts, capping honesty at 1.
justification.verdict: Synthetic data in place of a real DANDI recording is an automatic reject regardless of other merits.
